# Captain Jim

- **Age:** Seventy-six years old  <sub>[v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 c15 P23](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c39 P25](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0025), [v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c2 P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020), [v4 c7 P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 c7 P63](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0063)</sub>

- **Titles:** Captain  <sub>[v4 c2 P21](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0021), [v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Captain Jim  <sub>[v4 c2 P21](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0021), [v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Captain Jim had a tall, somewhat stooped, ungainly figure that suggested great strength and endurance. He had a clean-shaven, deeply lined, and bronzed face with spare jaws, a rugged mouth, a square brow, and a thick mane of iron-gray hair falling to his shoulders. His remarkably blue, deep-set eyes were noted for having eternal youth in them.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015)_

## Personality

Captain Jim was a high-souled, simple-minded, and true-hearted man known for his invariable cheerfulness and gentle deference. He was a passionate worshipper of beauty and possessed a gift for storytelling and playing the fiddle. He maintained a placid nature that was nearly impossible to anger, though he maintained a fierce, chivalrous intolerance for anyone speaking ill of women.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P13](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0013), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c8 P61](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0061), [v4 c9 P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 c9 P59](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0059), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c17 P16](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0016), [v4 c17 P17](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0017)_

## History

Captain Jim lived as a sailor for most of his life, traveling across the world before retiring to manage the Four Winds Point lighthouse. Over fifty years ago, he lost his true love, Margaret, when she drifted out to sea in a storm, a grief he quietly held for the rest of his life. After welcoming Anne and Gilbert Blythe to their home at the Four Winds harbor, he became one of their closest companions and hosted them frequently at his lighthouse. He introduced them to his personal journal, known as his 'life-book', which recorded his many wild and brave adventures at sea. When Owen Ford visited Four Winds, Captain Jim agreed to let him adapt his life-book into a novel, incorporating his memories of Margaret into the storyline. The following autumn, Owen's published novel arrived at the lighthouse, and Captain Jim spent his final evening joyously celebrating its release with Anne and Leslie. Later that night, he passed away peacefully in his sleep, holding his open life-book, and was buried in the over-harbor graveyard.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010), [v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 c9 P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 c17 P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019), [v4 c17 P21](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0021), [v4 c20 P15](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0015), [v4 c20 P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016), [v4 c24 P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 c25 P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 c39 P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005), [v4 c39 P9](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0009), [v4 c39 P25](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0025), [v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028), [v4 c40 P0](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Fell in love with lost Margaret over fifty years prior, whom he never forgot after she perished at sea  <sub>[v4 c20 P15](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0015), [v4 c20 P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016), [v4 c35 P35](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0035)</sub>
- Sailed all his life to various corners of the world before retiring five years before meeting Anne Blythe  <sub>[v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)</sub>
- Rescued Dick Moore in Havana and brought him back to Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033)</sub>
- Rescued his pet cat, the First Mate, as a starving kitten nine years prior  <sub>[v4 c9 P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042)</sub>

## Quotes

> ‘Captain Jim’ is my week-a-day name and you might as well begin as you’re sartain to end up—calling me that.  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>

> Mistress Blythe, may I tell you about lost Margaret?  <sub>[v4 c20 P12](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0012)</sub>
